title: Effective Potential Sketch
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately sketch the effective potential energy function V_eff(r) as a function of r, including the correct asymptotic behavior.

title: Max Potential Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the maximum value of the effective potential energy V_0 in terms of L and C, showing the correct relationship.

title: Cross Section Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the cross section sigma in terms of initial velocity v_0 and other relevant parameters.

title: Correct Use of Derivatives
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply derivatives to find critical points of the effective potential energy function.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide a clear physical interpretation of the results, particularly regarding the implications of the energy conditions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency of units throughout the derivations and final expressions.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the potential energy formula.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could simplify the problem or provide additional insights.
